digest.component_or_area: CLI help system and route registry
propositions: Twenty-one visible pure-intercept routes lack committed help artifacts and are absent from overview help discovery despite supporting rebar <command> --help
Identity child parsers disable their own help actions, causing rebar identity create --help and similar commands to reach top-level usage and exit with errors instead of returning child usage
Help route predicates across multiple census sites must use exactly not route.hidden and not route.retired without adding route metadata
Pure-intercept parser factories require nonblank overview descriptions in reconcile.build, enrich.build, identity.build, and certs.build_trusted_env to populate help discovery

Usage and metavar normalization helpers must be relocated from gen_cli_reference.py to gen_cli_help.py with conditional application to intercept routes lacking explicit parser usage while preserving explicit multiline trusted-env usage

Config validate --help must reach the build_validate handler and return validate child help rather than top-level config help because config validate is handler-dispatched without a populated argparse subparser action
